newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Fortis interested in all of MeesPierson.
newsitem.headline: Fortis interested in all of MeesPierson.

text.p: Dutch-Belgian financial group Fortis said on Friday it was interested in buying all of ABN AMRO's MeesPierson unit, rather than selective parts of the investment bank.
"We want to buy MeesPierson as a whole," Fortis spokesman Kees Leering told Reuters.

On Thursday Fortis said it was in talks with ABN AMRO over the possible purchase of MeesPierson, which has main offices in Amsterdam, Rotterdam and The Hague, and subsidiaries elsewhere in Europe, the Far East and the United States.
Its Dutch units include brokers Theodoor Gilissen and H. Wesselius & Co.
MeesPierson, which employs around 4,000 staff worldwide, including some 2,500 in the Netherlands, posted 1995 operating profits of 182 million guilders. Net profit was 250 million guilders.
